name: Keystone Realtors Ltd
title: Keystone Realtors Ltd - 543669 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Presales up 33% to INR4,022 cr with FY27 guide of INR5,000 cr and INR10,000 cr by FY30, but reported margins still carry legacy low-margin projects and revenue recognition is shifting, so cash and margin delivery remain unproven.

capex.quote: Our construction spend has accelerated from INR829 crores in FY '25 to INR997 crores, that's almost INR1,000 crores in FY '26.

guidance.quote: FY '27 guidance is INR5,000 crores. That's approximately a 25% growth.
Project launches will be about INR8,000 crores this year
I would like to guide it at about INR1,000 crores.
Our gross debt to equity will still be capped at 0.75:1.
It should not close about INR1,300 crores, INR1,400 crores as far as FY '27 is concerned.
from this year onwards, the collection efficiency should be in the range of 75% to 80%.
it should be about INR95 crores, that will be the sort of mathematics.

prior_guidance_check.quote: This is bang on in line with our guidance.

prior_guidance_check.metric: FY26 gross debt to equity guidance
prior_guidance_check.quote: Our gross debt-to-equity ratio remains comfortably within the guidance of 0.26: 1.

red_flags.label: Revenue 80% still completion-method; reported margins lag
red_flags.quote: 80% of the revenue has been accounted for by the CCM method, that is the completion method and only 20% has come from the percentage of completion.

red_flags.label: Collection efficiency declining
red_flags.quote: On the Slide 36, your comments in terms of the collection efficiency, how should we look at it because it's deteriorating every year?

red_flags.quote: So when we speak of about INR12,000 crores of the unsold goods, which is there

red_flags.label: Debt rising from INR755 cr to INR1,400 cr
red_flags.quote: at the end of the year, it will go to INR1,400 crores.

evasions.quote: We will provide that. We may like -- at this point of time, we have not basically come up with a number to guide on.
So without giving names, I can tell you that because the DA is still under finalization or under signing, I would not like to give names
